name: IndicatorParameters_Demo
summary: This is a utility EA that monitors chart indicators for changes (additions/removals) and retrieves their parameter information using the IndicatorParameters() function. It listens for CHARTEVENT_CHART_CHANGE events, compares the current indicator list with the previous snapshot, and prints details about added or deleted indicators along with their input parameters.
summary_zh: 这是一个工具型EA，用于监控图表上指标的变化（添加或删除），并通过IndicatorParameters()函数获取指标的参数信息。它监听CHARTEVENT_CHART_CHANGE事件，比较当前指标列表与之前的快照，并打印新增或删除指标的详细信息及其输入参数。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略，而是一个图表指标监控工具。它通过OnChartEvent事件监听机制，在图表发生变化时触发检测逻辑。核心机制是维护两个indicator_info结构体数组（新状态和旧状态），通过遍历和比对来发现指标的增删变化。当检测到新增指标时，调用GetParametersInfo函数获取该指标的类型和所有输入参数（包括整数、双精度和字符串类型的参数值），并通过Print输出到日志。仓位管理和资金管理方面完全不涉及，因为它不执行任何交易操作。该工具主要用于调试和开发，帮助开发者了解图表上挂载指标的配置情况。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a chart indicator monitoring utility. It uses the OnChartEvent event listener mechanism to trigger detection logic when the chart changes. The core mechanism maintains two indicator_info struct arrays (new state and old state), comparing them through iteration to detect indicator additions or removals. When a newly added indicator is detected, it calls GetParametersInfo to retrieve the indicator type and all input parameters (including integer, double, and string parameter values), printing them to the log. Position sizing and money management are completely absent since it does not execute any trading operations. This tool is primarily used for debugging and development, helping developers understand the configuration of indicators attached to a chart.

parameters.name: CHARTEVENT_CHART_CHANGE
parameters.description: 图表变化事件触发监控逻辑
parameters.description_en: Chart change event triggers monitoring logic

parameters.description: 上一次指标信息快照数组

pros: 实时监控图表指标变化，便于调试和开发指标相关功能
使用IndicatorParameters()获取指标完整参数信息，信息详尽且准确
结构化设计清晰，indicator_info结构体封装合理，代码可读性好
新增指标时自动打印参数详情，对指标配置排查非常有用
pros_en: Real-time monitoring of chart indicator changes, useful for debugging and developing indicator-related features
Uses IndicatorParameters() to retrieve complete indicator parameter information, detailed and accurate
Well-structured design with clear indicator_info struct encapsulation and good code readability
Automatically prints parameter details when new indicators are added, very helpful for indicator configuration troubleshooting
cons: 仅在CHARTEVENT_CHART_CHANGE事件时触发检测，无法捕获指标参数变更（如用户修改指标设置）
指标handle未在不再需要时释放（IndicatorRelease），可能导致资源泄漏
缺乏图形化界面展示，仅通过Print输出信息，用户体验较差
没有对IndicatorParameters()调用失败的错误处理，handle无效时可能崩溃
cons_en: Only triggers detection on CHARTEVENT_CHART_CHANGE, cannot capture indicator parameter modifications (e.g., when users change indicator settings)
Indicator handles are not released with IndicatorRelease() when no longer needed, potentially causing resource leaks
Lacks a graphical interface for display, only outputs information via Print, resulting in poor user experience
No error handling for IndicatorParameters() call failures; invalid handles may cause crashes
improvements: 添加IndicatorRelease()调用以释放不再使用的指标句柄，避免资源泄漏
增加对IndicatorParameters()返回值的错误检查，防止无效handle导致异常
增加对指标参数变化的检测（不仅是增删），通过对比参数内容发现修改
improvements_en: Add IndicatorRelease() calls to release indicator handles that are no longer in use, preventing resource leaks
Add error checking for IndicatorParameters() return values to prevent exceptions from invalid handles
Add detection for indicator parameter changes (not just additions/removals) by comparing parameter content to discover modifications

risk_points: 指标句柄未释放可能导致长期运行时内存/资源泄漏
IndicatorParameters()在无效handle上调用时缺乏错误处理
risk_points_en: Unreleased indicator handles may cause memory/resource leaks during long-running sessions
Lack of error handling when calling IndicatorParameters() with invalid handles
